messages.author: e64f7bb1494774f9
messages.subject: Read depth per sample
parts:
Hi dartR-ers,

Is there a way to extract the read counts per sample from gl.report.callrate? 


objectx<-gl.report.callrate(b, smearplot=TRUE, method="ind")


For example, read depth of 0,1, and 2 states across all loci? 


Essentially I am just trying to get an estimate of read depth per sample after filtering.


Thanks in advance,

Kate

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Read depth per sample
parts:
At the moment, we add to the locus metadata the read depth for the sequence tag. That is something that is fixed at the time DArT pass the data over to you. It does not change with any filtering you may do, and it cannot be recalculated after you have manipulated the data.

As I understand it, you would like to have the read depth for individuals averaged across all loci that are called for that individual (do you want zero read depth for loci not called included?).

If you confirm, then Bernd should be able to weave his apply magic to calculate this for you.

A

Thank you Arthur and Bernd!
